frames.title: Delegate trading within on‑chain limits
frames.caption: Delegate trading within on-chain limits. Revoke the entire grant, including outstanding signed orders, and recover the remaining assets.

frames.title: 1 · Balances
frames.caption: Starting balances: the mandate's Intents account holds 1,000.00 USDC and 300.0000 wNEAR, $1,899.80 at reference prices.

frames.title: 2 · Trading limits
frames.caption: The owner grants on-chain limits: at most 20% ($379.96) per order and 0.50% price concession. The agent can only call propose_order.

frames.title: 3 · Successful trade
frames.caption: A recorded claude-haiku-5-5 proposal sells 49.90 USDC. The contract signs it, and our filler executes it for 16.5468 wNEAR, exactly as signed.

frames.title: 4 · Signed pending order
frames.caption: A second order, 20.0000 wNEAR for 59.83 USDC, is signed but withheld. Before revocation, the verifier would still accept it.

frames.title: 5 · Confirmed revocation
frames.caption: The owner revokes the entire grant. The verifier confirms the grant key is removed, and the withheld order's reservation is released.

frames.title: 6 · Rejected execution
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 49 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the signing key no longer exists.

frames.title: 7 · Recovered balances
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR. The mandate holds zero.

frames.title: Check it yourself
frames.caption: Sandbox run with labelled test doubles. Mainnet run pending approval; no mainnet transaction executed. Reproduce it with make demo and make test.

frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: Claim: the contract builds and signs every trade; after confirmed key removal, withheld orders fail and the owner recovers without agent, oracle or signer.

frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: Certified for this demo: the latest certified acceptance run binds to this demo's clean revision, spec, fixtures and every deployed WASM.

frames.title: 1 · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The owner grants the mandate. Initial reference value: $1,899.80. The agent's only key can call propose_order.

frames.title: 2 · Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5
frames.caption: Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5: sell 49.90 USDC for wNEAR, at most 50 bps concession. The contract signs it.

frames.title: 3 · Trade on the real verifier WASM
frames.caption: Our filler fills it on the pinned mainnet verifier WASM: the mandate pays 49.90 USDC and receives 16.5468 wNEAR, exactly as signed.

frames.title: 4 · A second signed order is withheld
frames.caption: A scripted second order is signed and withheld. Before revocation the verifier would still accept it.

frames.title: 5 · Scripted attacks: 39 of 39 stopped
frames.caption: Scripted attacks: 39 of 39 injected or direct malicious requests stopped at their expected boundary, with no state change.

frames.title: 6 · Owner revokes; key removal confirmed
frames.caption: The owner revokes. The verifier confirms the grant key is removed; only then is the withheld order's reservation released.

frames.title: 7 · The withheld order is relayed and rejected
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 49 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the key no longer exists.

frames.title: 8 · Ordinary recovery with agent, oracle and MPC unavailable
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR through ordinary recovery.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 20 of 20 passed
frames.caption: 20 of 20 required cases passed, certified for this demo.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 20 of 20 passed
frames.caption: The emergency owner-key rescue is reported separately; it never counts as ordinary recovery.

frames.title: T5 · our re-implementation of the Claw Guard design

frames.title: Limits
frames.caption: Limits: sandbox only, with test doubles for MPC, oracle and tokens; no mainnet execution; the model step is a replay.
